item.name: 36 Group AB (publ)
item.description: Swedish listed company that on 13 November 2026 announced an agreement to restructure its financing arrangement with Loft Capital Limited, including the planned sale of pledged bitcoin, and a non-binding letter of intent on convertible financing of up to SEK 11.25 million that lapses if a final agreement has not been entered into by 30 November 2026, according to its MFN notice.

sources.title: 36 Group omstrukturerar finansieringsavtalet med Loft Capital och tecknar avsiktsförklaring om ny finansiering
